title: Missing slippage protection in trade closure
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  The closeTradeMarketCallback function (OstiumTradingCallback.sol) lacks slippage protection for the amount of collateral a trader receives when closing their position. When a trade closure is fulfilled (via a trusted forwarder), market conditions might be unfavorable compared to when the closure was initiated, resulting in the trader receiving significantly less collateral than expected.
